fields.title: Miami Life (Miami, Florida), Vol. 9, No. 2 (April 6, 1935)
creator: Life Publishing Company
subject: Gambling
Dog racing
Horse racing
Florida Legislature
Local politics
City commission elections
Loan sharks
Blackmail
Miami social life
Sports
fields.description: Issue includes political commentary and local opinion pieces (including discussion of Miami voters and city commission politics), criticism of gambling and the state-controlled racing system with figures from Florida dog tracks and horse parks, and columns such as "They Tell Me" and "Things I'd Like to Know." Also features consumer warnings about loan sharks and discussion of "blackmail" accusations, plus racing coverage and betting tips/"secret reports" (Bowie, Maryland and other tracks), along with extensive local advertising.
